fields.name: sourceText
fields.description: Transient carrier for the raw text block a scene was extracted from — the passage where its characters actually appear. Set on the in-memory scene map by extractChunkedInternal/extractScenesOnly and read by createFromScenes to REDUCE per-character detail from the RIGHT text. Declared (ephemeral) so it is a KNOWN field: without it RecordDeserializer logs 'Invalid field: olio.pictureBookScene.sourceText' and DROPS it on the Step-2 create-from-scenes round-trip (KI-24 pattern), silently starving the per-character reduce of its source passages. ephemeral => never persisted (the model is ioConstraints:['unknown'] anyway, so no DDL/storage). It must never reach an LLM (scenesForPrompt whitelists PROMPT_SCENE_FIELDS, which excludes it) and is stripped from the scene note JSON before persistence (createSceneNote).
